_about: Public-domain Increase Mather (1639-1723, minister of the Second Church, Boston, and president of Harvard) for the Word Hoard, from 19th-century editions, raw Internet Archive OCR: Remarkable Providences (ed. George Offor, London: J. R. Smith, 1856), Early History of New England (ed. S. G. Drake, Albany: Munsell, 1864), The History of King Philip's War (ed. S. G. Drake, Boston, 1862) and his Diary of 1675-76 (Cambridge, 1900). Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 11 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
